reconciliation.note: Each observation has exactly one disposition. Correlation never removes evidence, and explicit pass evidence is not inferred from engine silence.

issues.rationale: Two or more engines reported the same failure mechanism on the same resolved DOM target under the same test conditions. Every participating engine rule has an ACT mapping, but at least one was published for a different engine version.
issues.note: No engine owns the issue; the correlated identity does not depend on scan order.
